verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੈ ਦਯਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਤੇ ਅਰਥੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd sat sa(n)tokh hai dhayaa dharam te arath veechaaraa|

en.bdb: How great are the truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, the meaning (of a concept) and its further elaboration?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd kaam karodh hai kevadd lobh moh aha(n)kaaraa|

en.bdb: How much is the expansion of lust, anger, greed and infatuation?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd dhirasaT vakhaaneeaai kevadd roop ra(n)g parakaaraa|

en.bdb: Visitors are of many kind and how many are forms and their hues?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਥਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd surat salaaheeaai kevadd sabadh vithaar pasaaraa|

en.bdb: How great is the consciousness and how much is the extension of Word?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd vaas nivaas hai kevadd ga(n)dh suga(n)dh achaaraa|

en.bdb: How many are the founts of flavor and what is the working of various fragrances?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਦ ਨਾਦ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd ras kas aakheean kevadd saadh naadh oa(n)kaaraa|

en.bdb: Nothing can be told about the edible delights and inedible.
His expanse is infinite and beyond description.
